probe_results.final_answer: Constant Acceleration Velocity: Velocity update. Under constant acceleration, velocity changes linearly with time. $$ v = u + at $$ Where: input: u initial velocity input: a acceleration input: t time output: v final velocity A time-eliminated kinematic law is: $$ v^2 = u^2 + 2as $$ This relation still depends on the same motion quantities, but removes explicit time.
